UpdateSettingsDeviceRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/settings/devices/{mac}`.
All fields use patch semantics: null means "leave unchanged".

displayOnDashboard.description: Gets or sets whether the station is shown on the dashboard. Null leaves unchanged.

isPrimary.description: Gets or sets whether this is the primary/default station. Null leaves unchanged.

nickname.description: Gets or sets the user-assigned nickname. Pass empty string to clear.

selectedMetricKeys.description: Gets or sets the selected metric keys. Pass empty list to clear. Null leaves unchanged.

dailyExtremaTimezone.description: Gets the calendar-day timezone for daily high/low and history date queries: `utc` or `local`.

speedUnit.description: Gets the wind speed unit: `mph`, `kmh`, or `ms`.

temperatureDecimals.description: Gets the number of decimal places for temperature values: 0, 1, or 2.

Bearer.description: Paste your Auth0 access token (without 'Bearer ' prefix).
